title: Best Pressure Washers UK
short: Pressure washers compared by power, flow rate and included accessories, for cars, patios and driveways.
intro: A pressure washer's usefulness comes down to its balance of pressure, flow rate and the attachments it ships with, not just the headline bar figure. This guide compares washers tested by Expert Reviews on assembly, ease of use, cleaning power and value for money.

products.name: K4 Power Control
products.best_for: Buyers who want one washer that handles most jobs around the home
products.key_spec: 130 bar, 420l/hr flow, Power Control Gun with 3 pressure settings
products.summary: Expert Reviews' top pick, with a Power Control Gun and Vario lance that switches between three pressure settings and adjusts the spray pattern with a twist. Balances power, features and price better than its pricier K5 successor, though some rivals offer more raw power for the money.
pros: Great design with adjustable pressure settings
Wide range of Kärcher accessories available
cons: Some rivals offer more power for the money
products.search: Karcher K4 Power Control pressure washer

products.name: Core 130 Bike & Auto
products.best_for: Buyers who mainly want to clean a car or bicycle
products.key_spec: 130 bar, 462l/hr flow, includes car brush, foam sprayer and under-chassis nozzle
products.summary: Expert Reviews found this well-built and high-performance, bundling a wide-angled bodywork nozzle, soft car brush, under-chassis nozzle and foam sprayer that would normally cost another £40-50 separately. There's quite a lot of assembly involved and the warranty is shorter than some rivals.
pros: Power on a par with pricier machines
cons: Quite a lot of assembly required
products.search: Nilfisk Core 130 Bike and Auto pressure washer

products.name: EasyAquatak 110
products.best_for: Buyers who want a compact, easy budget washer
products.summary: A compact, suitcase-style washer that Expert Reviews found surprisingly powerful for its size and specs, easily removing caked-on grime from car bodywork and clearing moss from concrete. It's simple to operate with a single on/off switch, though the flow rate isn't enough for really big jobs.
pros: More powerful than specs would suggest
Easy to use with simple controls
cons: Not enough power or flow rate for bigger jobs

products.name: K2 Horizontal
products.best_for: Buyers short on storage space who want a trusted brand
products.key_spec: 110 bar, 360l/hr flow, suitcase-style with cable/lance storage
products.summary: Kärcher's entry-level washer, smaller even than the Bosch EasyAquatak, with smart storage features including a wind-round cable space and lock points for the trigger gun. Expert Reviews found enough power for cars and patios, though the single non-variable spray and short 3m hose limit versatility.
cons: Limited pressure and only a single spray pattern

products.name: PW20
products.best_for: Buyers who want a surprisingly capable washer at a low price
products.key_spec: 115 bar, 300l/hr flow, includes snow foam bottle
products.summary: A tiny price tag that belies genuine quality, according to Expert Reviews, blasting brake dust from alloy wheels and clearing algae from a patio, with a snow foam bottle included even at this price. It's louder and heavier than similarly-priced rivals, and has the lowest flow rate on test.

products.name: 130 Electric Pressure Washer
products.best_for: Buyers who want a built-in detergent tank for car shampoo
products.summary: Unlike rivals that need a separate detergent bottle, this has a built-in 0.9l tank you activate by twisting the lance, making car shampooing quick and even. Expert Reviews found the steel-braided hose resists tangling well, with only a fiddly hose release catch as a real criticism.
pros: Built-in detergent tank for easy car shampooing
Vario lance adjusts from spot spray to fan
cons: Not vastly cheaper than the more powerful Nilfisk Core 130

products.name: K5 Premium Smart Control
products.best_for: Buyers who want app control and maximum adjustability
products.key_spec: Bluetooth app control, upgraded adjustable lance, compatible with all Kärcher accessories
products.summary: The bigger, more powerful, Bluetooth-enabled version of the K4, with a genuinely useful smartphone app and even more adjustability on its lance. Expert Reviews was seriously impressed by the balance of grime-defeating power and all-round ease of use, at a premium price.
pros: Impressive balance of power and ease of use
Compatible with the full Kärcher accessory range

guide.q: What pressure (bar) do I actually need?
guide.a: For cars, bikes and general patio cleaning, 100-130 bar is plenty and less likely to damage paintwork or soft surfaces. Higher pressure mainly helps with larger areas or stubborn ground-in dirt, but flow rate (how much water is delivered) matters just as much as peak pressure for how quickly a job gets done.

guide.q: Does flow rate matter as much as pressure?
guide.a: Yes. A higher flow rate (measured in litres per hour) clears a given area faster, since it's moving more water rather than just hitting it harder. A washer with high pressure but low flow rate, common on cheaper models, can still take a long time on bigger jobs like driveways.

A foam nozzle or detergent tank is useful for car shampooing, a rotating brush helps with wheels and bodywork without scratching, and a surface cleaner attachment (like Kärcher's T5) speeds up flat areas like patios and driveways significantly compared to a standard lance.

guide.q: Is a smart, app-connected pressure washer worth it?
guide.a: An app-connected model like the Kärcher K5 here adds convenience for monitoring and adjusting settings, but it's a nice-to-have rather than essential. A simpler manual model with a good adjustable lance, like the K4 Power Control, gives most of the practical benefit at a lower price.
